name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked. Ink floods the box from a dot and the check is drawn; unchecking drains it. GPU-only.

theme.animate-godui-checkbox-draw: godui-checkbox-draw calc(var(--godui-duration-base) - 70ms * var(--godui-motion)) var(--ease-spring-smooth) calc(70ms * var(--godui-motion)) backwards
theme.animate-godui-checkbox-ink: godui-checkbox-ink calc(var(--godui-duration-base) - 70ms * var(--godui-motion)) var(--ease-spring-smooth) calc(70ms * var(--godui-motion)) backwards
